In the wall

~230LPs, all face-out

~48games, every title visible
  • Two thinner face-out trays in a ply bay: about 90 LPs and 120 singles each, both face-out.
  • Walls, ceiling and skirting in Card Room Green; the skirting in Estate Eggshell instead of white.
  • Power: the socket on the side wall in front of bay 1 becomes a double; Deco B runs from an always-on socket via the groove behind the right upright.

Lighting

  • The LED strip you have now, on the ceiling round the whole room, facing down.
  • A four-head cone spotlight bar on the existing rose, Wolston style: sage, blue, mustard and pink shades with wood toppers. Back pair on the shelves, front pair on the room, none at the TV.
  • LED grooves in the oak uprights and a bias light behind the TV.

The house and the living room

Traced from the agent's floor plans, with the alcove, chimney breast, kitchen brick cupboard and sloped ceilings added. Both Cat6 runs drop through the airing cupboard, right over the media wall's corner.
